verdict.rationale: Productboard's integrations directory says it can "Import sales & support conversations" and "Import messages containing ideas & feedback." It names a Zendesk integration for support tickets and a Microsoft Teams integration, and it automatically detects insights within incoming feedback. The API also lets teams route feedback from CRMs and other non-native sources, so all three channels are covered in principle, though the evidence is mostly one-line marketing claims. Missing for 10: named sales-call or recording-tool connectors, documentation of how chat and support capture is automated (triggers or sync behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
